start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:follow-through on my bakery wedding-cake orders: request is that every deposit promised this week is received or chased, scope is the order inbox and the deposits sheet, constraints are at most 3 reminders per customer, authorized actions are reading both and drafting reminders for me to send."
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: its three steps hand back one evidence-backed answer each, kept on the run record.
instructions: 1. Write the request (the commitments and dependencies to carry through), the scope, the constraints and authorized_actions; all four are required.
2. Say "Run workflow:follow-through". Answer step state: reconcile what is open now, with evidence, and review existing capabilities.
3. Answer step act: give every unresolved dependency a real owner, its source, the next event that matters, a finite boundary and a stop condition.
4. Answer step verify: check the consequence at its real destination, recover failures once the shared cause is repaired, and measure customer benefit when it applies.
5. Read each answer: an unresolved item without an owner and a next event is not done.
